notes: PRIMARY PUBLISHED ESTIMATE, UNCHANGED AND UNREPLACED. TAU2 DISCLOSURE: the tau2 column carries the value the manuscript function returns (5.628673589008228e-06, bit-identical in all three models). The substantive REML estimate is tau2 = 0 AT THE LOWER BOUNDARY: Q < k-1 in every model, the REML criterion is minimised at tau2 = 0 (verified in the run log section 4c), and the returned value is the bounded optimiser's tolerance-limited approach to that boundary (scipy xatol = 1e-5), which the manuscript's own 'tau2 < 1e-8 -> 0' snap does not catch. metafor 4.8.0 returns exactly 0 for all three models; carrying metafor's 0 instead moves each interval by <= 7e-5 and reproduces every zero-crossing verdict. Read tau2 as 0 (lower boundary), I2 = 0, i.e. no detectable between-cohort heterogeneity.
